comp: your-competition-id   (matches the competition id on the server; the manager fills this in)
_comment_launch: auto_launch (default true): the agent opens Packet Tracer itself if it isn't running. pt_path: optional override to the PT executable if auto-detection fails.
_comment_pt: ExApp credentials baked into ptagent.pta; register ptagent.pta once per machine (Extensions > IPC > Configure Apps > Add, then quit PT normally). Secret is local PT<->agent auth only.
_comment_levels: One entry per level. image/password = the sarpedon image + its per-image scoring key (also added to sarpedon.conf). pt_password = the activity's stored hash from `pka_tool -pass file.pka` (omit for unlocked activities). threshold mirrors levels.json on the server (display only; the server is authoritative). The .pka files are NOT shipped to students — the server releases them.
